published_prior_art.cite: janvin_stensrud_2025_challenge gives single-pathogen sharp challenge-effect bounds; BalkePearl1997 gives generic response-type LP bounds, but neither gives the stated external-margin, variant-history, bounded-priming projection.
Generic identified-set image and response-type sharpness arguments are established, but no inspected paper states this extended zero-denominator image for the proposed common-history vaccine fiber.
Finite-dimensional LP strong duality/Farkas certification supplies this audit equivalence generically.
Charnes-Cooper endpoint reduction is standard; the contribution is its application with common-history attainability and the disclosed priming fiber.
Endpoint-versus-unity trichotomy is direct interval algebra once sharp endpoints are available.
tomer_biccler_2022_temporal establishes temporal movement under modeled mechanisms, not an observable common-fiber LP dual certificate with lifting counterlaws.
The VE-direction translation is positive-denominator algebra under placebo-risk equality.
A worked four-atom response-type lift is a useful audit artifact but not an independent published-axis advance.
janvin_stensrud_2025_challenge supplies the single-pathogen survivor-selection boundary being recovered.
Union-over-sensitivity sharp-set reporting is standard in principle; its value here is integration with the proposed priming fiber.

gilbert_self_rao_2001_sieve and van_der_laan_gilbert_2023_caseonly give stronger-assumption case-only interpretations, not a necessary-and-sufficient sharp-set invariance frontier against external margins.
perenyi_stensrud_2025_variant identifies CSEk under its listed sufficient assumptions, while explicitly noting future work on sharp bounds under weaker assumptions.
tomer_biccler_2022_temporal does not furnish a fixed-fiber, attaining policy-mixture sign radius with sub-radius dual certificates.
romano_shaikh_2010_idset covers asymptotic whole-set inference generally; the proposed exact multinomial zero-cell projection is a model-specific unresolved specialization.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:sharp-reciprocal-endpoints and downstream finite-endpoint calibrations
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Finite Charnes-Cooper endpoints are conditional on ass:reference-risk-positivity, a separately stated fiber-wide denominator restriction.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The finite attained interval and LP endpoint claims are sharp conditional on LP-certified reference-risk positivity; the unconditional contribution is the extended sharp set.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 120(549), 2025, published version
source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and article description of Theorem 1.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article proposes the challenge effect, derives sharp bounds under nonparametric assumptions, and treats waning arising from survivor selection.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 5-6, Table 1 and Section 5, especially the CSEk formula.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines the time-to-event challenge subtype effect and identifies it as a ratio of observed at-risk cause-specific risk ratios under listed assumptions S18-S22.
The paper uses surveillance strain proportions to support variant-specific time-varying vaccine-efficacy estimation and requires those proportions to reflect the placebo-group strain distribution.
The paper constructs random sets for identified sets and known images with asymptotic pointwise and uniform coverage conditions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add a strict-separation theorem on an observable open class showing that the external-margin/priming fiber is not reducible to Janvin--Stensrud's multiple-exposure formulation or Perényi--Stensrud's hazard-identification assumptions.
Prioritize the case-margin invariance OEQ as a proved necessary-and-sufficient frontier, including a worked nondegenerate surveillance-versus-case-margin witness.
Specify a scientifically operational validation design that bounds delta and report how its sample information contracts the sensitivity envelope.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with exact common-history compression, sharpness/lifting, and the common-law dual certificate as the primary proof obligations.
